This row's attestation IS a checklist row -- the existing `checklist`-sourced hiq:baseball:2026:bowman-chrome:cpa-ba:black-white-red-ink:auto -- so the name says `checklist` and then says whose ruling extended it to this player. Verified: catalogAuthorityOf('checklist-drew-ruling-2026-08-30-red-ink') === 'checklist'.

CF-RED-INK-IS-THE-BW-SHIMMER-SSP (Drew, 2026-08-30): 'A SSP of the Black and white shimmer is Red Ink in Bowman autos FYI, so we need to add that to the catalog for matches.' The ruling's own instruction is 'ingest as-named if the source lists it; else mint drew-ruled rows under the CPA auto checklist' -- this file is the ELSE branch, for ONE card, and nothing wider.

WHY ONLY CPA-VF, AND WHY THIS IS NOT A LADDER SMEAR. checklistinsider lists 'Black & White Shimmer Refractor' and NO separate Red Ink rung (fetched 2026-09-08), so the published ladder cannot supply this row and a blanket per-player mint would be a cartesian smear over 500+ CPA subjects with no source behind any of them (feedback_no_synthetic_parallels_only_actuals, project_cartesian_printrun_smear). One card is minted because one card is attested.

THE ATTESTATION, measured in card_catalog 2026-09-08. The rung is ALREADY a checklist row in this product for a DIFFERENT player: hiq:baseball:2026:bowman-chrome:cpa-ba:black-white-red-ink:auto, source 'checklist', parallel 'Black & White Red Ink', Brailyn Antunez -- and CPA-BA carries a SEPARATE 'Black & White Shimmer' row beside it. Two rows, one player, both rungs: that is the catalog itself confirming Red Ink and Shimmer are distinct cards, exactly as the ruling says, and this file spells CPA-VF's Red Ink the SAME way that row spells CPA-BA's rather than inventing a name.

Corroborated by the market's own words in sold_comps (2026-09-08): '2026 Bowman Chrome, Black & White Refractor, Red Ink, Sam Petersen, Auto, CPA-SP'; 'Gage Stanifer 1st Bowman B&W Shimmer Red Ink Auto CPA-GS'; 'Marconi German 1st Auto Black and White Shimmer Refractor Red Ink'. Sellers name the Shimmer AND the Red Ink together, which is what an SSP-of-a-parallel looks like in listing text.

PRINT RUN IS BLANK ON PURPOSE. No source states one for this rung -- checklistinsider gives the Shimmer no run either, and the CPA-BA checklist row carries printRun null. Blank means unknown, never a guessed default (feedback_every_ingest_uses_the_one_checklist_format). rarity=SSP records the ruling's own word for the tier without claiming a serial number the card may not have.

WHAT THIS DOES NOT DO. It does not touch the existing Shimmer row (hiq:baseball:2026:bowman-chrome:cpa-vf:black-white-shimmer:auto, source 'checklist') -- per the ruling these are two cards and the Shimmer keeps its own pool. It does not retire the user-verified row at ...:black-white-red-ink-refractor:auto; that row is Drew's holding's current address and a retire is a separate, ledgered decision.
